actors.name: Kettlewell parish clerk
actors.private_context: The clerk posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are responsible for organizing the meeting and have no special knowledge about attendance.

actors.name: Villagers of Kettlewell
actors.private_context: The villagers have seen the notices about the open meeting. Some may recall that the last such meeting drew 22 attendees. They have varying levels of concern about the bus-route cut and may or may not attend.

shared_context: Kettlewell is a village. The parish clerk has posted notices about an open meeting to discuss the proposed bus-route cut. The meeting is scheduled to take place at a time and location specified in the notices. The last similar meeting about a different issue drew 22 attendees.

starting_events.description: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least thirty distinct villagers attended the open meeting before the meeting ends (which is before the hard cutoff). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
